profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Accomplished Software Engineer with career expertise in all stages of design, development, implementation, testing, and release of software products. Skills in building and optimizing data pipelines, leveraging infrastructure to implement and operate large-scale systems, collaborating with data scientists and product users to formulate problems, and building production-level monitoring systems that enable effective real-time decision making.

Software Engineering • Documentation • Data Analysis • Optimization Theory • Attention to Detail • Troubleshooting • Collaboration with Scientists • Process Improvement • Testing • Technical Support

Early career before PhD includes 3.5 years of software engineering in online video game and fabric CAD, working on both package type and backend service C++ and database.

TECHNICAL SKILLS 

C++ • JAVA • Scala • Python • Ruby • Spark • AWS • Distributed System with CI/CD • Jupyter • Zeppelin

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led incrementality measurement initiatives across Walmart's advertising ecosystem
•	Developed and deployed quality scoring frameworks for Display advertising sales lift metrics, optimizing the balance between data shareability and measurement reliability
•	Enhanced measurement coverage by implementing synthetic control methodologies to expand incrementality metric capabilities
•	Launched lift reporting solutions for Search and In-store advertising channels, leveraging various advanced incrementality measurement techniques

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and executed large-scale online experiments to optimize advertising performance across Facebook's newsfeed ecosystem
•	Reduced advertising performance bias from varying campaign setup, by improving ad retrieval mechanism.
•	Improved Facebook newsfeed ads performance measured in conversion, by implementing a quick feedback loop from user engagement to ad retrieval

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Sponsored Brands : Designed and implemented various components to serve Amazon and its advertisers.
•	Auction pricing models, including the function to reflect seasonality of Amazon retail cycle.
•	Campaign Performance Optimization to improve advertising performance.
•	Feature extraction to be used in response prediction models.

Display Ads : Developed an ad bidder from scratch to run multiple programs using machine learning algorithms.
•	Conducted in-depth analyses on the ad ranking mechanism in display advertising as a constrained optimization problem to meet business objectives, such as advertising performance and budget spend/allocation.
•	Operated CPM, CPC and CPA demand programs with features such as ad ranking, bid computation and pacing.
•	Built online experiment infrastructure which is used in multiple systems in Amazon advertising service.
•	Implemented personalized / context-based bidding logic and operated data pipeline for model building.
•	Built ad metadata indices from Amazon product catalogues to serve ad requests, with Elastic Beanstalk and Elasticsearch.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Apache Spark · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Optimization · Microservices · Python (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Ruby · Scala

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Implemented an extensible C library to simulate high performance networking switches. Analyzed latency and throughput at architecture level.
• Real silicon problems such as nonzero arbitration latency or finite queue size
• Various traffic patterns such as Bernoulli nonuniform or busty (e.g. video signal) traffic

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Macro modeling of bias circuits for various conditions in delay-locked loop (DLL)
• A model which can substitute DLL, to remove lock time in the beginning of circuit-level simulation such as Spice
